title: Pinned Rust toolchain and a writable build-out for the review workflow
summary: The review workflow's build job no longer writes into the runner's checkout. It creates a `build-out` directory, runs the build container as the runner's uid/gid with `base` mounted read-only and `build-out` mounted writable, and points `CARGO_HOME`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` there; the `osf` binary artifact and the work-item step now read from `build-out`. Jobs that mount `out` writable chmod it for the image user, and CI installs a pinned Rust 1.99.0 toolchain instead of adding components to whatever the image ships. The rest of the diff is test-only: `assert!(x.is_empty())` becomes `assert_eq!(x, Vec::<T>::new())` across the osf crates, plus new workflow-shape tests in `review_workflow.rs`.
